test_title: PYST 01: SSC JE ME - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word FOREIGN is arranged in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
Given word: 'FOREIGN'

After arranged in alphabetical order:

 
 

 Alphabets
 F
 O
 R
 E
 I
 G
 N
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 E
 F
 G
 I
 N
 O
 R
 
 

After arranged in alphabetical order,

None of the letters will remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
